about: The library graph of PrompTugal.news in the explorer's own shape (the same as api/v1/graph/explorer.json, so /assets/graph/explorer.js draws it unchanged). nodes[i]: {id, type, label, page?, src (index into sources, -1 for none), kind (the call class and subclass), by (the maker), status, category (the first subject), date, what, call, deg, bc (betweenness x1000), pr (PageRank x1000), x, y (a force layout)}. edges[j]: [from node index, to node index, verb index, source index or -1, read date or 0, edge betweenness]. Each connection is stored once, in the direction the card asserts it; the explorer reads it either way with the verb and its inverse. types[] may carry shape and color (the explorer draws each type with them) and presets[] is the graph's own list of named views, in the shape of PRESETS in assets/graph/engine.js (the explorer opens on the first). The reality tree: a root, 12 domains, 146 EXISTS entries and 258 PROPOSED entries (each a line of reality/<domain>/index.md or proposed/index.md), and the cards that evidence them. part_of runs entry to domain to root; evidenced_by joins an EXISTS entry to the card its evidence path names; proposed_in joins a PROPOSED entry to the card it names. status is exists or proposed. A domain with few entries is where the tree is thin. Generated by library.mjs 0.2.0; never edited by hand.
